attack_surface.boundary: keys at rest and in memory

mechanisms_implemented.does_not_guarantee: directories are 0755 (names visible); not enforced on Windows
mechanisms_implemented.guarantees: every secret goes through Vault__Secret_File: a 0600 temp file renamed into place, no readable window, no inherited mode, a link at the path replaced

secrets_exposure.note: see the dossier for the exact functions; TM-R14/TM-R15 cover keys on argv, stdout and disk

proposed.fix: treat an existing zero-length store as corrupt (refuse, name the backup path) and keep {} only for a missing file; a sentinel header in the plaintext so a new store is created only by an explicit `init`
proposed.test: unit: an emptied vaults.enc makes get/list/store raise, not reset

risk_decision.rationale: awaiting the step-4 verification or a fix

vulnerabilities.title: a truncated or emptied vaults.enc reads as an empty store, and the next `vault add` re-creates the store under whatever passphrase is supplied: a local writer (A6) silently resets the credential store, and a mistyped passphrase on an empty store becomes the store's passphrase
credential store uses one fixed global salt: equal passphrases give equal master keys on every machine
